about: Design tokens for the RigCheck Android re-skin. Light theme only. Brand source: web/src/design-system/tokens.css and Color.kt (already identical). Every colour below that is not in that source is listed under proposed_changes so Web can follow.

brand.name: orange
brand.use: Primary action fill. Ink text on top, never white. Never used as text on white.

brand.name: teal
brand.use: Top app bar fill, secondary fills. Ink text on top.

brand.name: purple
brand.use: Scan credit badge, Partially Checked and Not Enough Information verdict band, avatar. White text on top.

deep.name: orange-deep
deep.use: Orange as text or icon on white or a tint.

deep.name: teal-deep
deep.use: Secondary button border and text, ghost button text, focus border, links.

deep.name: purple-deep
deep.use: Purple as text; option-card border; section labels on purple tint.

support.name: pine
support.use: Pass: verdict band, row icon, bar fill, badge text, Free badge fill.

support.name: danger
support.use: Fail: verdict band, bar fill, error borders, destructive button. White text on a fill.

neutral.name: ink
neutral.use: Body text and headings. Text on orange and teal fills.

neutral.name: surface-sunken
neutral.use: Quiet notices, empty states, Results page background.

neutral.name: border-strong
neutral.use: Input and control outlines (3:1 on white).

neutral.name: tint-teal
neutral.use: Focus ring, Manual card, plan badge.

neutral.name: tint-purple
neutral.use: Scan card, new-rig panel, Pro offer card.

neutral.name: tint-orange
neutral.use: Stand-alone panel, scan and estimate notices, disclaimer icon tile.

proposed.name: danger-text
proposed.use: Fail as text or icon on white or tint-red (danger #b5473a is 4.4:1 on tint-red; this is 5.8:1).

proposed.name: tint-red
proposed.use: Over-limit badge fill, error notice, expanded row note on fail.

proposed.name: on-teal-wash
proposed.use: Back button and account status row on the teal bar.

proposed.name: keyboard-placeholder
proposed.use: Design frames only. Not an app colour.

gradients.name: sky
gradients.use: App icon background and splash icon disc only.

typography.font_loading: Today both load at runtime from Google Fonts, so the first launch offline falls back to Roboto. Recommendation: bundle Outfit (600, 700, 800) and DM Sans (400, 500, 700) as app resources. This needs the owner's OK because it adds about 300 KB. If not bundled, keep the fallback.
typography.numbers: Weights are pounds with thousands separators. Use tabular figures (fontFeatureSettings "tnum") on the Results values and percentages if the font supports it; otherwise right-align the percentage as drawn.

elevation.name: sm
elevation.use: Resting cards, buttons, chips, top bar.

elevation.name: md
elevation.use: Verdict band, pinned reference card, dialogs, sheets, toast.

essential: Row note expand and collapse (200 ms, standard easing)
optional: Dialog fade and scale from 92% (200 ms)

material3_mapping.notes: Verdict band colours come from the verdict tone: SUCCESS uses success, WARNING uses error, INSUFFICIENT uses tertiary. A failing row is never drawn in colour alone.

proposed_changes: Add danger-text (#9a3a2e), tint-red (#f8e6e3), tint-green (#e8f0e5), disabled-fill (#e4e0ee) and disabled-content (#6a647c) to the shared brand tokens so Web can use them.
Add the sky gradient (#7b3fe4 to #ff7a1a) for the launcher icon and splash; Web can use it for the favicon.
Add a 56 dp button height and a 48 dp compact height; Web buttons today are shorter.
Add elevation footer (0 -8 24 rgba(22,19,31,0.08)) for pinned action bars.
